title: Resolution urging Albany to extend tax breaks for HDFC co-ops
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass A.2707B/S.880B, which would permanently extend the DAMP tax exemption for income-restricted Housing Development Fund Corporation (HDFC) cooperatives, set to otherwise expire in 2029. The bill would also let HDFCs choose a tax abatement option and allow the City to forgive tax arrears for HDFCs that agree to greater oversight. About 1,048 HDFCs with roughly 25,000 apartments and 75,000 residents citywide would be affected.
